changelog: Rebuilt for Jellyfin 12.4 on Media-Serv (lsheardo-12.4 branch) from upstream 1.7.5. Security: a Roku opened a PIN-protected profile without asking for its PIN, plus further security fixes. Fixed: an unreadable configuration file wiped every household; a rejected picture deleted the old one; a failed settings load could be saved over the real settings.
description: Adds multi-user profile switching to Jellyfin. A single account can have up to five isolated profiles — each with its own watch history, parental controls, and library access.
name: Bonfire
